def remove_all_cts_records_by(self, crypto_idfp):
        """
        Remove all CTS records from the specified player
        :param crypto_idfp:
        :return:
        """
        self.log.info("Removing all CTS records for player %s", crypto_idfp)
        cts_records = self.get_all_cts_records_by(crypto_idfp)
        if cts_records:
            for cts_record in cts_records:
                self.remove_cts_record(cts_record)
        return cts_records
